judgments.reason: The paper title and abstract explicitly describe the creation and contents of the NOD dataset, stating it was extended by collecting MEG and EEG data.
judgments.paper_title: A large-scale MEG and EEG dataset for object recognition in naturalistic scenes

judgments.reason: The paper describes MNE-BIDS, a tool and specification for organizing electrophysiological data into the BIDS format, which is a general technical method, not a paper introducing the NOD-EEG dataset.
judgments.paper_title: MNE-BIDS: Organizing electrophysiological data into the BIDS format and facilitating their analysis
judgments.paper_venue: The Journal of Open Source Software
